description:
Keep your iPhone screen awake while charging, then return to your usual Auto-Lock behavior when you unplug. PlugLit uses Picture in Picture to play a bundled charging animation and show the system battery level. Start it with one tap or configure a charger automation in Shortcuts. Screen-awake behavior depends on iOS support and device state.

• Start or stop charging PiP with one tap.
• Runs while connected to power; unplugging stops playback without changing your Auto-Lock duration.
• Supports iOS 15 and later. On iOS 17 and later, two Shortcuts actions let you create personal automations for charger connection and disconnection.
• Preview, export or clear diagnostics containing the model identifier, system version and necessary runtime state. Feedback is optional.
• No account or ads. The charging animation plays offline.
• Interface, guide and in-app privacy policy in English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Korean. Follows system language preferences, with English as the fallback.

Before you start: iOS controls PiP size and position; the app cannot automatically hide it at the screen edge. Behavior depends on iOS, other media and device state; continuous display is not guaranteed in every situation. Plugging in while locked may require unlocking first. The app does not bypass passcodes. Keeping the screen on and playing video increases power use and heat. After playback stops, iOS decides when to lock; an Auto-Lock setting of Never is not overridden.
